topThreats.title: Hackers Exploit Two GeoServer Flaws as Researchers Warn of Unauthenticated RCE Chains
topThreats.summary: Threat actors are actively exploiting two newly patched security flaws in GeoServer, according to watchTowr. topThreats.remediation: Board/Executive: Mandate immediate emergency asset sweep for exposed interfaces. Task Execution: Apply vendor patch or emergency WAF virtual patch, audit access logs for IOCs, and restrict management ports.

topThreats.title: Drupal Warns of New Highly Critical Site Takeover Vulnerability Under Active Exploitation
topThreats.summary: Drupal has warned of a new "highly critical" security flaw impacting Drupal core that it said has been exploited in the wild. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-136716 (CVSS score: N/A), has been described as a case of improper checking for unusual or exceptional conditions.
topThreats.remediation: Board/Executive: Evaluate organizational exposure against NIST CSF 2.0 governance metrics. Task Execution: Verify endpoint telemetry in SIEM, apply vendor security mitigations, and cross-reference internal asset databases.
